segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin, including some with congested pores, blackheads, and acne, report reduced pore appearance, fewer breakouts, and better oil control, with no complaints of stripping.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry or dry-leaning skin report the product does not dry them out further and one describes it as hydrating, though one non-sensitive reviewer with dry-prone skin reports severe peeling and dryness near the eyes and temples.
segments.combination: Combination and combination-oily reviewers report clearer skin, fewer breakouts, and smaller-looking pores after weeks of use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers mostly report good tolerance with gradual introduction (starting at 1-2x/week) and smoother, calmer skin, though one reviewer who identifies as not sensitive reports her skin was badly burned and peeled.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 30s and one in her 40s report smoother skin and improvement in fine lines/hyperpigmentation after incorporating the product into a routine.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report smoother texture and some fading of fine lines and hyperpigmentation with continued use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the product is hydrating or does not dry out their skin, including one with very dry skin; one reviewer, however, reports severe drying and peeling after use.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports temporary redness and stinging on application that subsides quickly; most others report no redness or irritation.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive or reactive-skin reviewers generally report no compromise to their skin barrier when introduced gradually, though one reviewer reports her skin barrier was severely damaged with peeling and dryness after standard use.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers with blackheads, whiteheads, and clogged pores report visible reduction within days to weeks; one reviewer after three weeks reports no change yet.
concerns.blemishes: Numerous reviewers with hormonal, cystic, or persistent acne report clearer skin and fewer breakouts over weeks, including faster healing of active blemishes; one reviewer reports the product caused severe, painful cystic acne.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers report better oil control and less clogged, congested-feeling skin; one reviewer disputes any oil-control benefit and calls the formulation too weak to work.

I bought this because I wanted to try a liquid exfoliator. As part of my night time routine, after applying to my face, I applied the extra to the back of my hands like I always do. Not only did I wake up with my face feeling super smooth and soft, the eczema on my hands that I had been struggling with for over a year improved significantly. After a few more uses, my eczema disappeared. GAME CHANGER! I recommended to some friends who also have eczema, and they said theirs went away too; they even used it for their kid's eczema. I will buy this product forever!

I have VERY dry skin and have stayed away from this product because I was afraid that it would dry me out. However, I am constantly dealing with small breakouts from wearing a mask all day one, especially on my chin. I recently added this to my routine and it is so gentle and effective, I'm beyond thrilled. It has noticeably controlled my breakouts while not drying me out at all.

I love that this is an exfoliant designed to be compatible with daily use. I have sensitive, dry-leaning skin and some similar products can strip it a bit too much, but I use just a little bit every day and haven't had any problems. My face is noticeably clearer and brighter, and this is the only change I've made to my routine. Very pleased.

I am in my 30's with sensitive skin and many allergies (both food and environmental) that often cause my face to breakout. I was worried this might aggravate my skin, but I was able to quickly adjust to multiple applications a week without any ill side effects. My face has never felt so smooth and I believe this product helps my serums and moisturizer to work better too! The Add-to-Cart podcast introduced me to this brand and product, and I could not be happier. Support AAPI companies!

I have been using this product for a week now and my skin has never been better. I use this product with their vitamin c serum and hyaluronic acid moisturizer. The results are amazing. This products has really helped me in clearing up my skin! I suffer from congested oily skin; I have a lot of blackheads, enlarged pores, and stubborn whiteheads. I literally have tried everything to help my skin but after 6 years I have found the right product for me. However, if you have never tried any BHA products on your skin try to introduce it slowly. This does make my face red when I apply it and can sting just a bit. Nevertheless, it goes down in a second and my skin starts to glow.
